source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U23: Identify the LLP entity,partners and designated-partner requirements

payload.title: The LLP is the contracting entity
payload.core_explanation_md:
An LLP is an incorporated body distinct from its partners and continues through partner changes. The ordinary Partnership Act does not generally supply its rules. Individuals and qualifying bodies corporate may be partners,while the designated-partner requirement uses individuals,including the appropriate nominees of corporate partners. The described minimum is two partners and two designated partners,with the prescribed Indian-residence requirement.

The 2021 amendment changes the residence wording to at least120days during the financial year; the sourcebook repeats the older182-day preceding-year wording. Separately,if an LLP knowingly carries on with a sole partner beyond six months,the described personal exposure concerns obligations incurred during the relevant later period. Do not treat this exception as making every partner personally liable for every LLP debt.

self_check.prompt_text: Why distinguish a partner from a designated partner?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The designated role carries specific compliance responsibilities and eligibility requirements.

payload.stem_md: A body corporate is a partner and the file proposes appointing that corporation itself as a designated partner instead of an individual nominee. What is required?

options.text_md: No LLP may have a body-corporate partner
options.explanation_md: The source permits qualifying corporate partners.

options.text_md: The designated role must be held by the required individuals
options.explanation_md: Corporate partnership and individual designation are distinct.

options.text_md: Only the corporation logo must be registered
Every employee automatically becomes a designated partner

payload.correct_explanation_md: Corporate partnership and individual designation are distinct.

payload.stem_md: A draft uses the old182-day preceding-year residence test despite the2021 section7 amendment. Which test does that amendment introduce?

options.explanation_md: That is not the stated test.
The amendment substitutes the relevant days and period wording.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The amendment substitutes the relevant days and period wording.
